title: Problems hidden by PHPUnit's error handler
body:
When PHPUnit does not register its error handler
```patch
diff --git a/src/Framework/TestResult.php b/src/Framework/TestResult.php
index d8a87e52f..378c2950d 100644
--- a/src/Framework/TestResult.php
+++ b/src/Framework/TestResult.php
@@ -627,7 +627,7 @@ public function run(Test $test): void
 
         $errorHandlerSet = false;
 
-        if ($this->convertErrorsToExceptions) {
+        if (false && $this->convertErrorsToExceptions) {
             $oldErrorHandler = \set_error_handler(
                 [ErrorHandler::class, 'handleError'],
                 \E_ALL | \E_STRICT
```
then the following problems are revealed

- [x] `strpos(): Empty needle in /usr/local/src/phpunit/src/Framework/Constraint/StringStartsWith.php on line 46`
- [x] `Undefined index: stdout in /usr/local/src/phpunit/src/Runner/PhptTestCase.php on line 180`
